scope: Proposed ten-build roadmap, ten customer archetypes and a separate simulated VC lens. No fresh live audit, interviews, implementation, or experiments performed in this review.

scoring.fit: Independent simulated judgments of conceptual usefulness if correctly delivered. 25 optional, 50 useful, 75 central, 90+ essential. Fit is not readiness, probability, measured demand or a future score.
scoring.independence: Three separately prompted review agents covered four early-career archetypes, four professional archetypes, and two buyer archetypes plus VC. Each read the existing evidence, not the other agents' new results. All are AI perspectives from the same model family.
scoring.combinedFormula: (sum of ten customer readiness scores + VC evidence-readiness score) / 11. Planning breadth indicator with equal weights, not market/customer population weights. Do not substitute fit scores.

archetypes.name: Final-year graduate applicant
archetypes.job: Find a plausible graduate role and turn completed academic/internship evidence into a truthful first application.
gates: Graduation, start-date, professional-experience and sponsorship conditions are separate from CV wording; unknowns remain visible.
Coursework and projects never silently satisfy required professional experience; the Python counterfactual is stable.
Original vacancy source and checked time remain inspectable; exact one-page preview matches export and source deadline appears in tracking.
archetypes.assumption: Permitted sources contain enough suitable graduate roles, and conditions review helps selection rather than merely adding warnings.
archetypes.experiment1: Observe first and second applications using fictional facts and permitted postings; compare normal preparation with the prototype, counterbalance order, record assistance/corrections and all abandoned tasks.
archetypes.experiment2: Offer optional reuse during a fourteen-day study with genuinely relevant manually checked roles; distinguish study-prompted visits from voluntary return.

archetypes.name: Internship seeker with little experience
archetypes.job: Identify defensible contributions from projects, coursework and volunteering without inventing employment or impact.
gates: A person with no employment history can complete the record and export without manufactured leadership, employment or numbers.
Individual contribution, team work, completion and unfinished study retain their original meaning.
Audience/sign-in changes preserve inputs without granting consent; phone correction and draft recovery work.
archetypes.assumption: A short guided interview exposes evidence users understand and can defend without making onboarding burdensome.
archetypes.experiment1: Test sparse fictional records with consenting internship seekers; inspect comprehension and approved facts for invented experience or ownership.
archetypes.experiment2: Test enrollment, graduation-window and start-date conditions against source snapshots and ask users to explain known, unknown and next action.

archetypes.name: MBA consulting applicant
archetypes.job: Produce a tightly edited, defensible packet and stay ahead of a concentrated recruiting timetable.
gates: Chosen page length follows explicit bullet/section selection, without silently dropping facts or context.
Work, internships and classroom projects remain distinct; projected savings do not become measured results.
Dated application/interview milestones and a second employer packet reuse confirmed facts; stories do not imply case-interview readiness.
archetypes.assumption: Packet editing and the timetable materially improve the existing document/calendar routine.
archetypes.experiment1: Compare two fictional employer packets with the existing method; measure relevance, attribution, editing effort and preview/export equivalence.
archetypes.experiment2: Run a recruiting-calendar comprehension task with timezone/unknown deadlines and inspect whether users can recover after interruption.

archetypes.name: MBA industry/finance/product pivot applicant
archetypes.job: Choose a target direction and translate existing experience into role-specific evidence without inventing a bridge.
gates: Separate target directions have explicit priorities, rather than one blended keyword score.
MBA coursework remains distinguishable from professional/technical experience requirements.
Two directions yield meaningfully different evidence selections from one record; confidential or withdrawn facts stay excluded.
archetypes.assumption: Direction guidance identifies an actionable bridge, rather than producing polished packets for materially unsuitable roles.
archetypes.experiment1: Use one fictional career record for two different directions and test evidence-selection explanations with consenting pivot candidates.
archetypes.experiment2: Compare recruiter briefs built from the same facts; inspect whether candidates understand aspiration versus demonstrated qualification.

archetypes.name: Busy employed midcareer switcher
archetypes.job: Prepare the next relevant application with little repeated effort and clear discretion controls.
gates: A second vacancy reuses confirmed facts, with new/changed material surfaced for review.
Employer exclusions have an enforced documented scope; confidential claims are inspectable before sharing.
Opt-in runs survive browser closure, recover without duplicate packs/charges, expose paused/failed/unavailable states and preserve phone/sign-in progress.
archetypes.assumption: A short action queue replaces current work instead of becoming another dashboard to maintain.
archetypes.experiment1: Five consenting switchers compare normal versus reused first/second-packet tasks with fictional facts; measure active minutes, repeated fields and corrections.
archetypes.experiment2: Simulate a week including closed roles, budget/source holds and changed facts; test recovery, state comprehension and pause controls without sends or live integrations.

archetypes.name: Senior manager/director/executive
archetypes.job: Express leadership scope accurately across a selected CV, leadership brief and interview evidence.
gates: Personal ownership, team contribution, organisational outcomes, scope and dates remain distinct; supported never becomes led.
Output type/length is explicitly selected; seniority and confidential commercial metrics are not invented.
Manager, director and executive tasks are validated separately; confirmed facts alone do not prove a persuasive narrative.
archetypes.assumption: Factual selection can support leadership framing without extensive additional candidate judgment.
archetypes.experiment1: Test synthetic records containing ambiguous scope, shared results and confidential metrics with qualified reviewers across seniority levels.
archetypes.experiment2: Blindly compare generic and senior-focused fictional packs for fidelity, relevance, seniority signalling and correction effort.

archetypes.name: Career returner after an employment gap
archetypes.job: Build an honest target-role narrative with accurate chronology and optional gap disclosure.
gates: Historical results never become recent achievements, and employment continuity is not manufactured.
Gap explanation is optional; sensitive personal reasons are not required to complete the workflow.
Current skill evidence, recent study and employer conditions are distinct; exact dates and disclosure choices survive exports.
archetypes.assumption: Preparation is a major pain alongside role direction, confidence and recent evidence, rather than a faster generic CV missing the need.
archetypes.experiment1: Five consenting returners use fictional dated records and optional gap explanations; test completion without forced disclosure or invented continuity.
archetypes.experiment2: Test known/unknown eligibility and next-action comprehension using permitted posting snapshots and fictional records.

archetypes.name: UAE international/relocation applicant
archetypes.job: Create usable mixed-script documents and dated actions while distinguishing employer conditions from assumptions.
gates: Chosen Arabic/Latin name forms survive glyphs, shaping, direction, rendering and copy/paste in each supported format.
Analysis language is stated; mixed-script names do not imply fully bilingual CV analysis.
Employer-stated location, sponsorship, pay currency/period and dates stay quoted; unknowns remain unknown, and Dubai date-only actions behave correctly.
archetypes.assumption: Permitted sources contain enough relevant roles with useful conditions detail; broad UAE labels and substrings are insufficient.
archetypes.experiment1: Test synthetic mixed-script names, long lines and punctuation across preview, PDF, DOCX, text extraction and copy/paste.
archetypes.experiment2: Five consenting participants interpret unknown sponsorship, remote locations, pay periods and Dubai dates from permitted source snapshots without inferred eligibility.

archetypes.name: Independent career coach/adviser
archetypes.job: Review accurate current packets with less reconstruction and version confusion.
gates: Source quotations, exact document version and factual/disclosure approvals remain linked in a review bundle.
Candidate grants explicit scoped access, corrects facts, renews approval and can revoke the coach's access.
Coach comments never become candidate-attested facts automatically; source/approval history is clear.
archetypes.assumption: A source-linked review handoff saves enough adviser time to replace email/document reconciliation.
archetypes.experiment1: Five consenting coaches review matched fictional packets with and without evidence bundles; record review time, version confusion and seeded material errors.
archetypes.experiment2: Test grant, comment, correct, reapprove and revoke in a prototype; all participants must understand what is visible and locate the current version.

archetypes.name: University/MBA careers programme buyer
archetypes.job: Support successive cohorts with reliable review and useful reporting without heavy administration.
gates: Role-scoped staff/candidate permissions, accessibility, support and reporting scope are tested.
Cohort data identifies actual activity and candidate-reported outcomes, with consent and accurate denominators.
A real workflow owner, budget/procurement route and continuation decision are verified; consumer usefulness alone is insufficient.
archetypes.assumption: An institution has a costly unmet task and realistic adoption path despite existing careers software.
archetypes.experiment1: Interview five consenting actual buyers about their existing tools and one costly workflow; require independent evidence of a common task, owner and evaluation path.
archetypes.experiment2: Test minimal cohort administration with fictional participants; a funded small pilot and renewal test can occur later only after eligibility and buyer requirements are resolved.

builds.name: Personalized entry and target-role brief
builds.customerSees: A landing page, example and starting task suited to their audience, with editable target roles and constraints carried into onboarding.
builds.implementation: Shared audience configuration powers the three initial landing routes and task defaults; add additional paths only after validating distinct needs. Preserve audience through guest navigation and sign-in without putting personal data into URLs.
builds.automatic: Carry the selected context forward and suggest relevant starting fields/examples.
builds.human: Choose or change audience, target direction and constraints.
builds.acceptance: Each initial audience enters on phone/desktop, changes choice and signs in without input loss or silent consent; can explain current capabilities.
builds.current: Homepage audience choices exist; distinct planned routes and full carry-through need implementation/verification.

builds.name: Reusable verified career record
builds.customerSees: One readable record of employment, projects, skills, dates, contribution, outcome and sharing choices, with every fact linked to its source.
builds.implementation: Parse existing inputs into editable suggestions, start with three guided facts, retain source/version context, track correction/withdrawal dependencies and reuse only confirmed shareable facts.
builds.automatic: Parse, suggest, categorize, reuse and identify missing/conflicting information.
builds.human: Confirm factual accuracy and allowed disclosure; keep confidential or sensitive facts private.
builds.acceptance: First and second vacancies use the same record without retyping; team ownership, unfinished work, chronology and projected results retain meaning; account boundaries hold.
builds.current: Cloud record/claim controls exist; guided setup and connected guest reuse remain gaps.

builds.name: Permitted source-backed vacancy discovery
builds.customerSees: A short useful list showing why each role fits, the original posting, checked time, conditions, closing uncertainty and next action.
builds.implementation: Start with permitted employer feeds or maintained source-backed lists. Canonicalize/deduplicate postings; keep full text and source provenance. Separate posting evidence from preference matching and do not treat snippets as verified vacancies.
builds.automatic: Fetch permitted sources, deduplicate, extract and rank; label unavailable or incomplete data.
builds.human: Choose directions, confirm ambiguous conditions and decide which roles to pursue.
builds.acceptance: Each target cohort sees genuinely useful sourced roles; closed/incomplete sources are clear; budget-exhausted discovery is distinguishable from zero suitable results.
builds.current: Manual vacancy intake and source adapter code exist; enabled useful external discovery was not demonstrated in the audit.
builds.dependency: Permitted source access, B4 conditions and B10 cost controls

builds.name: CV-to-vacancy evidence and conditions review
builds.customerSees: Supported evidence, unresolved requirements, qualifications, dates and employer conditions, each with the relevant quote and a useful next question.
builds.implementation: Scope uncertainty to its actual fact/skill; classify conditions separately from achievements; remove metadata noise and keep original sources inspectable. Correct the reproduced Python, sponsorship and date-guidance defects before expanding the funnel.
builds.automatic: Extract and organize requirements, find relevant evidence and flag conflicts/unknowns.
builds.human: Resolve missing facts and employer questions; confirm suitability without invented qualifications.
builds.acceptance: Counterfactual and attribution/negation/date fixtures pass; no unrelated quotes support conditions; academic evidence never silently establishes required professional experience.
builds.current: The source-conscious check exists with reproduced precision/guidance defects.
builds.dependency: Source record and complete vacancy text

builds.name: Exact-preview application-pack studio
builds.customerSees: A real page preview, source-linked change list, safe length/section choices, editable CV, evidence report, letter and reviewed preparation material.
builds.implementation: Bind approval to immutable rendered versions; provide explicit safe shortening/undo; handle output format readiness independently where appropriate; verify mixed-script glyphs/shaping and chosen name forms.
builds.automatic: Select confirmed facts, render, validate layout/length and prepare supported formats.
builds.human: Review exact wording/layout and approve facts and disclosure; select material changes.
builds.acceptance: Approved preview matches download; editing revokes affected approval; no silent fact/name loss; a format failure has clear recovery and preserves independently valid outputs.
builds.current: Prior hosted evidence supports generation and hashed downloads; actual layout preview, length recovery and Arabic-name support need improvement.

builds.name: Durable opt-in recurring Job Loop
builds.customerSees: A controllable cadence, next run, useful action queue and honest progress, including paused, blocked, failed and recovered work.
builds.implementation: Extend checkpointed cloud runs with explicit schedule/timezone controls and bounded source/model work. Preserve priced Claude/GPT/Kimi adapters, consented recipients, retry reservations, cancellation and rules fallback. Optional inbox needs its own verified permission/setup.
builds.automatic: Repeat discovery/preparation, deduplicate work, checkpoint, recover and compile in-app actions.
builds.human: Opt in, set preferences, pause/cancel, answer essential questions and approve outputs; sending/submission stay user controlled.
builds.acceptance: A consented run survives browser closure and interruption without duplicate artifacts/charges; source unavailability and budget holds remain visible; model changes do not bypass consent or the shared cap.
builds.current: User-triggered cloud execution exists in prior release evidence; paid providers/mail are disabled and daily scheduling is absent.
builds.dependency: B3 supply, B10 budget/operations; optional external approvals

builds.name: Private progress workspace and next actions
builds.customerSees: One page with Today, applications, deadlines, exact document versions and a timeline of their actions and automated work.
builds.implementation: Connect check/record/packet/tracking through one application identity. Record substantive actor/time/status/source/version events. Protect drafts, provide clear field recovery and compact mobile review. Keep external application statuses explicitly reported or source-confirmed.
builds.automatic: Update real internal progress, dated actions, prepared versions and recovery states.
builds.human: Review next actions; confirm external submission/interview changes unless a verified integration observed the event.
builds.acceptance: First/second applications stay linked without duplicate entry; Privacy/Back, refresh, sign-in and interrupted runs recover; dates respect timezone; no other account can read the workspace.
builds.current: Tracking and cloud opportunity views exist, but continuity is fragmented and guest navigation loss was observed.
builds.dependency: B2/B5 version links and B10 isolation

builds.name: Recruiter and interview preparation
builds.customerSees: A role-specific recruiter brief, draft messages, contribution stories, likely evidence questions and unresolved gaps.
builds.implementation: Reuse approved source facts and posting context. Distinguish aspiration from experience, projected from measured results and individual from team scope. User-supplied/verified contact and thread context remain explicit; no guessed recipients or automatic sending.
builds.automatic: Prepare factual drafts, organize stories and suggest relevant review questions.
builds.human: Choose framing, verify recipients/context and handle conversations/interviews/submission.
builds.acceptance: Material claims trace to confirmed facts; withdrawal updates dependent drafts; consulting packet quality never implies case-interview readiness; no unsupported achievements appear.
builds.current: Some letter/draft preparation is present; a coherent recruiter/story preparation journey is proposed.
builds.dependency: B2/B4/B5 and separate permission for any future integration

builds.name: Permissioned coach and cohort review
builds.customerSees: Optional scoped review: candidate shares a specific current version, coach comments, candidate corrects/reapproves and can revoke access.
builds.implementation: Begin with a versioned candidate-controlled handoff before a large portal. Add staff/candidate permissions, scoped comments and aggregate programme reporting only after buyer-workflow validation; preserve candidate factual/disclosure authority.
builds.automatic: Assemble review bundles and update authorized progress/current versions.
builds.human: Grant/revoke access, provide adviser judgment, confirm corrections; programme procurement remains a real buyer process.
builds.acceptance: Grant/comment/correct/reapprove/revoke works without wrong-version confusion or unauthorized visibility; cohort reports state sources and denominators; adviser comments never silently become confirmed facts.
builds.current: A fictional coach demo/free pilot exists; a shared review/cohort product has not been verified.
builds.dependency: B2/B5/B7/B10 and evidence of an unmet buyer workflow

builds.name: Reliable low-cost operations and commercial foundation
builds.customerSees: Working support, understandable privacy/control, recoverable failures, accurate availability/limits and a product an operator can maintain.
builds.implementation: Verify support/erasure handling, account isolation, dependency/licence/source inventory, backup/restore and operator handover. Measure useful-pack cost and minimal consent-appropriate funnel/quality events. Keep billing disabled; prepare verified checkout/entitlement/refund/reconciliation only for later eligible launch.
builds.automatic: Budget reservations/reconciliation, safe validation, operational monitoring and minimal progress metrics.
builds.human: Operate support, resolve incidents/rights/account eligibility and make informed commercial decisions.
builds.acceptance: Known trust/recovery defects close; isolation/withdrawal/recovery and cap boundaries are freshly tested; support and restore fulfill actual rehearsals; ownership/transfer paths and costs are evidenced.
builds.current: Significant technical controls and tests exist; support, production recovery, channel economics, ownership/transfer diligence and commercial proof remain incomplete/unverified.
builds.dependency: Verified operational ownership, source rights and later merchant eligibility

vc.lens: Simulated VC evidence-readiness and transferability review; no actual investor, valuation, fresh authenticated audit or legal diligence.

readinessDimensions.name: Problem/ICP definition
readinessDimensions.basis: Explicit audiences/tasks; human demand validation unavailable.

readinessDimensions.name: Product usefulness/completion evidence
readinessDimensions.basis: Fictional journeys and prior hosted mechanics; material gaps and no fresh authenticated independent run.

readinessDimensions.name: Repeat-value measurement
readinessDimensions.basis: Reusable-record design exists; voluntary return and second-task behaviour unmeasured.

readinessDimensions.name: Paid demand/unit economics evidence
readinessDimensions.basis: Cost controls/planned offers; observed useful-pack cost and commercial demand unavailable.

readinessDimensions.name: Distribution/CAC evidence
readinessDimensions.basis: Entry/pilot surfaces exist; attributable channel economics unavailable.

readinessDimensions.name: Defensibility
readinessDimensions.basis: Provenance/approval/version foundation; demonstrated comparative advantage unproven.

readinessDimensions.name: Execution/operations
readinessDimensions.basis: Prior tests; support inconsistency and production recovery/external services untested.

readinessDimensions.name: Source rights/access
readinessDimensions.basis: Manual-source/bounded design; permitted ongoing supply inventory unverified.

readinessDimensions.name: Institutional procurement
readinessDimensions.basis: Conditional simulated coach recommendation; real workflow owner, procurement and funded continuation unverified.

readinessDimensions.name: Transferability/IP/accounts
readinessDimensions.basis: Portable code/runbooks; ownership assignments, actual migration paths and entity readiness unverified.

vc.unknownInterpretation: Low evidence-readiness judgments mark missing proof, not measurements of zero customers/revenue or an assertion that the business has no value.
vc.wedge: Coach-assisted MBA/experienced-pivot first and second applications using a candidate-supplied vacancy, verified facts, exact packet review and dated next action. Hypothesis to test, not proven demand.
gates: Observed first/second task usefulness and voluntary repeat use at equal source/output quality.
Comparative adviser/candidate correction and time evidence, with failed and assisted tasks included.
Permitted vacancy supply, actual channel economics, support load and fully costed useful-pack economics.
Validated coach/programme workflow owner and procurement/continuation evidence where that channel is targeted.
Fresh task/isolation/withdrawal/recovery tests plus source/licence/IP/account ownership and transfer/migration verification.
Eligible arrangements and verified billing/refund/reconciliation when commercial launch is later authorized.

sources.title: Teal free/paid feature comparison
sources.supports: Resume creation/tracking are established free-plan expectations; AI and analysis tools are offered separately. Advertised features only.

sources.title: Huntr Advisor
sources.supports: Adviser review, activity timelines, curated roles and organization reporting are established marketed features, not inherently novel.

sources.title: Handshake career centres
sources.supports: Institutional employer access and reporting are a broad established product category.

sources.title: Handshake reporting documentation
sources.supports: Reporting has role permissions and institution-scoped data; a consumer tool alone is not an institutional product.

sources.title: VMock
sources.supports: Markets an AI career-services platform for higher education; discovery search snippet available, homepage text extraction empty. No private product test or outcome verification.

constraints.capScope: Shared model/search usage; not an all-in hosting/support/tax or subscription budget.
constraints.billing: Pending; disabled. Owner's entity/permit constraint remains unresolved.
